name: sunear-designer-stage
description: Internal Stage plugin for testing Sunear door and window design workflows through OAuth-protected MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Internal testing only - never use for customer production projects.
interface.longDescription: Internal Sunear testing plugin. It signs in through the isolated Stage account system and creates projects only in the Stage database.
defaultPrompt: Use Sunear Stage to test a door and window project from an uploaded PDF or image.
